title: Parenting
definition: Parenting is the God-given responsibility of raising, teaching, correcting, loving, and guiding children in wisdom and truth.
summary: Parents are called to shepherd children with patience, discipline, instruction, affection, and prayer. Parenting is not about control, but faithful stewardship before God.
christFocus: Christ welcomes children, values them, and teaches parents to lead with humility, love, and dependence on God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Parents are called to shepherd children with patience, discipline, instruction, affection, and prayer. Parenting is not about control, but faithful stewardship before God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
